The person on the left is female with long dark hair; the center person is male with a blue sash/stole; the person on the right is male wearing sunglasses. They are posing closely together, with arms around each other's shoulders.

Specifically, the arm of the person on the right wrapping around the center person seems to merge slightly with the center person's gown without a clear boundary or hand structure visible.
